Weight Basis — See Both Sides

Revenue/Yield measures always use CWeight and Cost measures always use AWeight for their ₹ impact (not user-editable — see definitions above). This table shows what the impact would be under either weight, for the currently loaded Base/Comparison months, so you can see both and confirm which one the dashboard actually reports (✓).

Editable Calculation Settings

Lane Targets & Lane Structure Live for everyone

Saved on the server (sheets LANE_ORIGIN, LANE_DEST, LANE_TARGETS of the engine spreadsheet), so every user sees the same lanes and targets. Each uploaded target file is one Target set: uploading it again replaces only that set. Targets can be for a Lane, Circle, Zone or Branch / Destination, per Week, Month or Day, with From / To dates.

Sign Convention

Comparison Month − Base Month is used for every delta. For revenue metrics (Basic Yield, Gross Yield): positive delta = favourable, negative = adverse. For cost metrics (Cost/kg): positive delta = adverse (more cost), negative = favourable (cost saving). Net P&L Impact = Revenue Impact − Cost Impact.
